# PDFCompact

> PDFCompact is a free collection of PDF tools that run entirely in the browser. Files are processed locally with JavaScript and are never uploaded to a server. No account, watermark, or file limit.

PDFCompact is a project of [PDF Canada](https://pdfcanada.ca/).

## Tools

- [Merge PDF](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one document in the order you choose.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/split): Split a PDF by page ranges or every N pages.
- [Rearrange Pages](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/rearrange): Reorder PDF pages by dragging thumbnails.
- [Remove Pages](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/remove-pages): Delete unwanted pages from a PDF.
- [Extract Pages](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/extract): Pull specific pages out into a new PDF.
- [PDF to Text](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/pdf-to-text): Extract plain text from a PDF.
- [PDF to Word](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/pdf-to-word): Convert a PDF to an editable .docx file.
- [Image to PDF](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/image-to-pdf): Combine JPG, PNG, or WebP images into a PDF.
- [PDF to JPG](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Convert PDF pages into JPG images.
- [Edit PDF](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/edit-pdf): Add text boxes and highlights to a PDF.
- [Sign PDF](https://pdfcompact.com/tools/sign): Draw or type a signature and place it on a PDF.
